descriptions.listCountries: Lists active countries. Inactive countries are excluded.
descriptions.getCountry: Returns an active country. Inactive countries are treated as not found.
descriptions.listCountryStates: Lists states for an active country in ascending ID order. Inactive countries are treated as not found.
descriptions.listSatMeasurementUnits: Returns measurement units in ascending ID order, including timestamps in the America/Monterrey time zone.
descriptions.listSatKeyOfProductsAndServices: Returns product and service keys in ascending ID order, including timestamps in the America/Monterrey time zone.
descriptions.listOrganizationalPortalIdentificationTy: Lists identification types for the organization. A missing, blank, or unknown organization_id returns HTTP 404.
descriptions.listSiteOrganizationAccounts: Lists active clinician profiles selected for the organization's site, sorted by name. Use the numeric organization ID from the branding response. Each profile includes a location when available and the first available weekday through Sunday, or null when there is no remaining availability that week. Availability accounts for agenda configuration, busy intervals, pending requests, and organization closures.
descriptions.showWaitingRoomBySlug: Resolves an active waiting room by its canonical slug or by an active entry-point slug. A canonical room match takes precedence. Entry-point links return entry_point metadata for the parent room. Pass entry_point.id when joining the queue to retain the origin of the visit. A canonical link returns entry_point as null. An unknown or inactive destination returns an empty HTTP 404.
descriptions.showSiteOrganization: Resolves public organization branding by encoded slug or encoded custom domain, with plain slug or host fallback. Linked accounts are ordered by account ID.
descriptions.listPatientPortalPeople: Lists the non-deleted people authorized for the patient portal token, newest first. The response includes chat availability; a chat-service connection failure can cause the request to fail.
descriptions.showPatientPortalPersonMedicalHistory: Returns medical history when the patient’s organization has enabled sharing. Free-text allergies appear in records.allergies. Catalogue entries are returned separately in medical_history_allergies, which can be empty. If there is no active history, this read creates a new medical history record. The editable flag reflects the organization’s patient-editing setting.
descriptions.listPatientPortalPersonOrganizationPorta: Lists the personal booking link, eligible organization schedules, and visible telehealth waiting rooms for the authorized patient, in that order. Availability depends on the organization subscription and each portal's scheduling and visibility settings. Organization schedules and waiting rooms are ordered by ID. Appointment history does not determine eligibility.
